d25:
Do sticky ads hurt or help?

One ad unit often pays for itself if you do it right. A sticky ad stays on screen as readers scroll, so it's almost always seen, and advertisers love that. Done wrong, as a giant banner over your content, it makes readers leave.

Keep it small, run it on mobile only or as a slim desktop version, always add a close button, and never put it over the content.

Did you know ads.txt has a twin?

ads.txt lives on your site and lists who may sell your ad space. sellers.json lives on the seller's side and lists who they sell for. Together they let a buyer trace every impression back to a real publisher, which is what lets bigger budgets reach smaller sites. Keep your business name and domain consistent everywhere.
